newsitem.title: USA: CILCORP to take $0.40/shr charge in Q4.
newsitem.headline: CILCORP to take $0.40/shr charge in Q4.

text.p: CILCORP Inc on Monday said it would record an after-tax charge of $5.4 million, or $0.40 a share, in the fourth quarter of 1996 to account for an early retirement program.
The company said the program at its utility subsidiary, Central Illinois Light Co, would result in annual after-tax cost savings of about $2.6 million in 1997.
CILCORP said 76 of the 210 eligible CILCO employees signed up for the voluntary program.

It is the second early retirement program offered by CILCORP in the past year. The company took a $7.8 million charge in the fourth quarter of 1995 to cover an early retirement program in which 166 employees participated.
CILCORP is the parent of Central Illinois Light.
Its stock closed unchanged Monday at 37-1/4 in trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
